The system starts from a frozen 2B vision-language embedding model, then trains only an audio connector—a query-based resampler—and modality-gated deep adapters attached to each decoder layer. The gate is closed for non-audio inputs, so text, image, and video pathways remain unchanged. The embedding is Matryoshka-nested with a default 1024-dimensional readout. Total pretraining data covers about 888.8K clips, and the added lexical-speech round contributes roughly 150K spoken-word clips, 70K read-speech clips, plus audiobook data. Pretraining uses a frozen-text memory bank, false-negative masking, and soft labels.

The paper’s real contribution is how it rules out alternative explanations and turns the “discriminative axis” idea into a testable mechanism. First, it establishes the capability trade-off induced by lexical speech: keyword recognition rises sharply while emotion recognition drops. Second, it uses a much smaller prosody-controlled corpus, Crema-D, to show that emotion can be recovered quickly, so the issue is not representational capacity. Third, it constructs a matched-exposure negative control using 29,428 mined clips whose captions explicitly name emotions; this produces essentially no emotion recovery, showing that explicit textual mention is not sufficient. Fourth, it rules out representational truncation and broad collateral degradation: truncation explains only a small fraction of the gap, and a nine-task board shows no general collapse. Finally, the authors define a separability statistic computed from the corpus itself to estimate whether an attribute is required for negative separation, and they validate the mechanism causally by restructuring the same audio so that emotion becomes the required discriminative axis. Emotion performance recovers under this intervention, whereas merely increasing in-batch caption similarity does not.

Compared with typical work, this is not a new loss or a larger model. It is a careful decomposition of “data quality” into a more precise variable: whether the training corpus structurally forces the model to rely on the target attribute during contrastive discrimination.db:T843,There are four key result blocks. First, after adding the lexical-speech round, zero-shot keyword spotting improves by 76 points, while speech-emotion recognition drops by 14 points. Evaluation is done on SpeechCommands (35-way keyword spotting) and Ravdess from the MAEB audio embedding benchmark in the MTEB framework, using shared-space matching between audio embeddings and class-text embeddings.

Second, the capacity explanation is directly rejected. Starting from the same post-speech checkpoint and using a fixed fine-tuning recipe—batch size 128, peak learning rate 3e-5, no gradient accumulation, false-negative masking and soft labels disabled—the authors fine-tune on Crema-D, a prosody-controlled corpus with only 7,442 clips. After just 150 steps, emotion rises from 0.211 to 0.508, surpassing the pre-speech level of 0.348, while keyword accuracy only falls to 0.845, still far above the pre-speech level. At 400 steps, the trade-off worsens, suggesting that the shorter schedule is the better operating point. The paper also quantifies the exchange rate: around 150 steps, roughly six emotion points are recovered per keyword point lost; between 150 and 400 steps, that rate drops to about two.

Third, the data-volume explanation is also rejected. Fine-tuning on 29,428 mined clips with captions that explicitly mention emotion, under matched exposure, changes emotion by only -0.0007—effectively zero. So more data, even with explicit attribute naming, does not trigger attribute learning.

Fourth, the mechanism is tested more directly. Representational truncation recovers only about 18% of the gap, and a nine-task board shows no broad degradation that could hide a positive effect. Most importantly, when the same audio is reorganized so that emotion becomes the required discriminative axis, emotion improves by +0.089 on average across three seeds. By contrast, simply increasing in-batch caption similarity does not produce the same recovery. This is the crucial control that separates “more similar text supervision” from “a corpus structure that forces reliance on emotion.”dc:T500,For a skim-level read, focus on the causal chain rather than the audio specifics. The same directional pattern is confirmed across 8 cells when repeating the audit with KV-cache eviction methods (KVPress, SnapKV).de:T56b,The paper has three technical layers. First, it reframes memory retrieval as an implicit non-parametric policy and the stored utility score as a proxy reward. Under this view, writing high-scoring episodes and reusing them later is a form of policy improvement in memory space. The Echo Gap is then defined as a systematic mismatch between self-assessed reward and true success, amplified by retrieval frequency.

Second, the paper provides a diagnosis through the Error-Independence Assumption (EIA). The key claim is that a stronger verifier is not sufficient if its errors are correlated with the original self-grading bias. The recoverable benefit of correction depends on two quantities: how well verifier scores align with true utility, and how decorrelated verifier errors are from the original bias. This is the most useful conceptual contribution: correction requires not just more capability, but a different error channel.

Third, the paper proposes mitigation through per-memory de-inflation rather than global calibration. A label-blind global remapping of scores cannot identify which specific memories are overvalued. Instead, the authors argue for memory-specific demotion using auxiliary signals that are less likely to share the same bias. They instantiate this idea with an answer-free de-inflation method and test it in a Memento-style retrieve–inject–write loop.df:T55b,The experiments are split into bank-level diagnosis and end-to-end behavioral impact. At the memory-bank level, the paper shows that incorrect episodes are systematically over-rewarded across the studied model families and factual memory banks, and that the inflation correlates with future reuse. This is not mere random judge noise. More capable re-graders are often better on average, but their residual errors can still align with the original self-grading bias, which limits their corrective value.

At the agent level, the paper evaluates a faithful memory loop on BIRD text-to-SQL. The agent retrieves similar past episodes, injects them into context, solves the current task, and writes the new episode back without access to ground-truth labels at write time. Final evaluation uses official execution accuracy. The reported result is that self-graded write-back progressively corrupts the memory bank, while the proposed de-inflation method consistently improves over the self-graded baseline across random seeds. This shows that the Echo Gap is not only a scoring artifact; it translates into measurable behavioral degradation.

The provided content supports the qualitative findings and the structure of the empirical evidence, but it does not expose complete tables or trustworthy exact numbers. It would therefore be inappropriate to fabricate precise gains.e0:T578,The methodology is built around three complementary diagnostics. Sensitivity is measured by Layer-Wise Representation Divergence (LRD), defined as cosine divergence between mean-pooled hidden states for clean and perturbed inputs at each layer. Two summary statistics, slope across depth and recovery rate from early to late layers, are used to classify models into spike-and-suppress versus late-accumulation regimes. Causality is measured with activation patching: at each layer, the clean hidden state is inserted into the noisy forward pass, and the authors record how often originally failed examples are recovered. To avoid over-interpreting weak patching signals, they introduce an identity-patch gate: only models with at least 80% recovery under all-layer clean patching are treated as confirmed for causal conclusions. Compensatory capacity is measured by training LoRA adapters in different layer windows and comparing repair gains against regressions on clean computation. The proposed explanation for the dissociation is cascade disruption: an adapter placed early may locally counteract perturbation damage, but because it changes the entire downstream computation, it can break parts of the clean-input trajectory that were otherwise intact. The paper supports this mechanism with downstream disruption profiles and controlled layer-placement sweeps across multiple perturbation types.e1:T486,The study covers five models: Phi-3.5, Gemma-2-9B, Llama-3, Mistral, and Qwen2.5-7B, plus within-family scaling scans for Qwen2.5 from 1.5B to 14B and a smaller Llama family check. Two propagation regimes emerge. Phi-3.5 and Gemma-2-9B show spike-and-suppress behavior, where early divergence is partially absorbed later. Llama-3, Mistral, and Qwen2.5-7B show late accumulation, where divergence keeps growing toward the output. The paper also reports that a no_failure classification at the IPI-exposed assistant turn predicts a secure trace with 92.9% precision.e3:T97e,方法分三段。第一段是架构转换。作者从 Qwen3-0.6B-Base 出发，保留每 4 层中的 1 层原生 GQA，共保留 7 层，其余 21 层替换为 KDA。KDA 配置包括 16 heads、head dim 128、短卷积 k=4、q/k L2 norm、低秩 forget gate、beta write gate、gated RMSNorm、NoPE。这样做不是纯线性模型，而是混合结构：75% 层用 O(1) recurrent state，剩余层仍保留线性增长 KV cache。作者还详细分析了 forget gate 初始化，指出几乎不遗忘会让 recurrent state 爆炸，遗忘过强又会比随机还差，最终采用 g6 初始化，forget half-life 中位数约 6.3 tokens。

第二段是两级蒸馏。先做 layer-wise hidden alignment：每个 KDA 层对齐对应 teacher hidden state，teacher 冻结，误差跨层 detach，只训练 KDA 参数 193.6M，学习率 1e-4 到 1e-5，batch 为 8192 tokens/step。这个阶段把 CE 从 9.48 拉到 4.125，但 C-Eval 仍只有 25.5%。随后做 end-to-end forward KL distillation，在预训练文本上最小化 teacher-student next-token 分布的 forward KL，不混 CE；训练范围扩大到 KDA + 全部 MLP + LayerNorm，共 457.9M 参数，embedding、lm_head 和保留的 7 个 attention 层冻结。为适配单卡显存，作者实现了 chunked fp32 KL，避免物化全量 logits。7000 steps、总计 57.3M tokens 后，valid CE 到 2.9385，teacher 为 2.8108，gap 仅 +0.128 nats，valid KL 0.160，但 C-Eval 只有 28.8%。

第三段是诊断与修复。诊断上，作者构造了 161 道来自训练语料、与 benchmark 零重叠的四选一题，每题做四次 cyclic option rotation，内容不变，只旋转 A/B/C/D 标签。若模型跟随内容，正确标签应随 rotation 改变；若只是知识丢失，预测应更接近均匀随机。实际结果是学生模型 81.06% 时间选 A，161 题中有 106 题在四次 rotation 下都保持同一标签，且正确选项平均 margin 为 -0.117 nats。这说明它不是单纯不会，而是输出接口塌缩到了标签偏置。修复上，作者加入一个 1000-step 的 Stage 3b，用 completion-only KL 在 teacher 验证过的 MCQ permutations、诗歌、翻译 QA 上做格式修复。这个阶段不追求全面分布拟合，而是专门修补“问题-选项-答案”接口。之后再做 persona alignment，包括 SFT、identity booster 和一轮 on-policy DPO，并用 15 个 benchmark guard points 监控遗忘。e4:Tb2e,The method has three stages. Stage 1 is architecture conversion. From Qwen3-0.6B-Base, every fourth layer remains native GQA, leaving 7 full-attention layers and replacing the other 21 with KDA. The KDA stack uses 16 heads, head dimension 128, causal short convolution with k=4, L2-normalized q/k, low-rank forget gates, beta write gates, gated RMSNorm, and NoPE. This yields a hybrid model rather than a pure linear-attention model: 75% of layers use O(1) recurrent state, while the retained GQA layers still have linearly growing KV cache. A notable engineering point is gate initialization. The paper shows that near-total retention destabilizes the recurrent state, while excessive forgetting performs worse than random; their adopted g6 initialization gives a median forget half-life of about 6.3 tokens.

Stage 2 is two-step distillation. The first step is layer-wise hidden-state alignment: each KDA layer is trained against the corresponding teacher hidden state, with the teacher frozen and errors detached across layers. Only KDA parameters are updated in this phase, 193.6M trainable parameters total, at 8,192 tokens per step. This reduces CE from 9.48 to about 4.13, but C-Eval stays at chance. The second step is end-to-end forward-KL distillation on pretraining text. The objective is pure forward KL between teacher and student next-token distributions, without mixing in CE. Trainable parameters now include KDA, all MLPs, and all LayerNorms, 457.9M in total, while embeddings, tied lm_head, and the 7 retained attention layers remain frozen. To fit a single 32GB GPU budget, they implement chunked fp32 KL instead of materializing full logits. After 7,000 steps over 57.3M tokens, validation CE reaches 2.9385 versus the teacher’s 2.8108, a gap of only +0.128 nats, with validation KL 0.160, yet C-Eval is still only 28.8%.

Stage 3 is diagnosis and repair. The diagnostic is a four-permutation multiple-choice test: 161 clean four-option questions are constructed from the training corpus with zero benchmark overlap, and each question is evaluated under four cyclic rotations of option labels. A content-following model should track the correct option as labels rotate; a model that simply forgot should fail roughly uniformly. Instead, the converted model predicts “A” 81.06% of the time, and 106 of 161 questions keep the same predicted label under all four rotations. The average margin on the correct option is negative, -0.117 nats. This points to label-interface collapse rather than uniform forgetting. The repair stage then runs 1,000 steps of completion-only KL on teacher-verified MCQ permutations, poetry, and translation QA, explicitly targeting the question-option-answer interface. Persona alignment is added afterward via SFT, an identity booster, and one round of on-policy DPO, monitored with 15 benchmark guard points.e5:T7b9,Four results matter most. First, immediately after conversion, the adopted g6 gate initialization gives held-out CE 9.48, versus 3.01 for the teacher, showing that naive surgery is highly lossy. The paper also compares extreme forgetting and extreme retention, showing that one collapses performance below random while the other destabilizes the recurrent state. Second, layer-wise hidden alignment reduces CE from 9.48 to roughly 4.13, but C-Eval remains around the 25% random baseline, demonstrating that hidden-trajectory matching is insufficient for restoring decision behavior. Third, end-to-end KL distillation over 7,000 steps and 57.3M tokens yields validation CE 2.9385 versus teacher 2.8108, only +0.128 nats apart, with validation KL 0.160, yet C-Eval reaches only 28.8% compared with the teacher’s 50.6%. This is the key empirical point: LM loss nearly recovers, but task ability does not. Fourth, the format-repair stage lifts C-Eval from 28.8% to 41.3%, and the final persona-aligned model reaches 41.83%. Label stickiness is roughly halved, and the correct-option margin turns positive, but validation KL worsens from 0.160 to 0.196, indicating a measurable trade-off between interface repair and general distribution matching.

The ablations are also informative. Two generations of projection transplant fail for different reasons: v1 did not actually transplant meaningful teacher projections at all, with cosine near 0 to the teacher and about 0.69 to random init; v2 performed a transplant that was functionally almost orthogonal to the teacher, with mean cosine only 0.007. In v3, abandoning projection transplant improves functional probe cosine to 0.434. This suggests that in heterogeneous replacements such as attention-to-KDA, parameter-shape compatibility does not imply functional transfer. The implementation notes on bf16 update swallowing and cache bugs are also useful because they isolate architecture failure from plain engineering mistakes.e6:T50f,The analysis is built on an abstract conditional model: the residual representation is written as F(x)=F0(x)+∑i αi(x)vi, where vi is a fixed carrier direction and αi(x) is an input-dependent coefficient. A linear readout s(x)=ψ(F(x))+b determines the decision sign. For a matched pair (xA,xB), the paper proves three main results. First, deleting a subset of carriers collapses both inputs to the same unconditional output if and only if the removed mass is symmetric on the pair and no contrast remains outside the deleted subset. The induced error is deterministic, and all subsets satisfying the condition produce the same collapse. Second, patching carrier i shifts the readout by βiδi, with βi=ψ(vi) and δi=αi(xA)-αi(xB), whereas ablating carrier i shifts it by -βiαi(xB). These quantities do not bound each other. The paper constructs cases where every single-carrier patch flips the decision but no single-carrier ablation does. Third, for the non-independent case of an attention head and its own layer’s MLP separated by RMSNorm, the paper derives an explicit interaction error with a second-order remainder bound. The correction vanishes for MLP-only ablation, but not for head ablation, because removing the head also perturbs the input seen by the same block’s MLP.e7:T447,The central notion is gauge equivariance: an optimizer is equivariant if it behaves consistently under orthogonal rotations of the latent factor basis. A structure theorem shows that a memoryless update is equivariant iff it takes the form Δ=H(GG^T)G, a left preconditioner determined by the Gram matrix. Under this classification, GD, Polyak momentum, Adam with a shared scalar second moment, Muon (including its Newton–Schulz iterates), and Shampoo's Kronecker preconditioner with damping are equivariant; Adam, RMSProp, signSGD, Lion, and Adafactor break equivariance because they apply entrywise nonlinearities at zero state. An exact first-step defect is derived for zero-initialized Adam. A transfer theorem shows that dynamics under a shared scalar preconditioner equal gradient flow under a rescaled time, so existing low-rank/minimum-nuclear-norm results for gradient flow carry over. Equivariance is necessary but not sufficient: low-rank convergence also depends on the spectral schedule over singular values attracting dynamics to the low-rank manifold within the training budget.e8:T86b,The system starts from a merged PR and reconstructs the corresponding task condition on a healthy descendant revision of the same repository. The lifecycle is formalized as follows: a historical source patch P_s transforms V_pre into V_post; Change2Task starts from a healthy modern base H, applies a task patch D to create a task state C, and records a restoration patch G that returns C to a restored state H'. The goal is behavioral restoration, not textual identity.

The framework has four main stages. First, it extracts task evidence from the PR: description, implementation patch, and executable checks. From this it derives target checks, regression checks, and a source change profile. The source change profile later serves as a fidelity constraint, ensuring that the reconstructed task remains close to the original maintenance intent and edit footprint. Second, it selects a healthy modern base revision, preferring explicitly declared healthy or target revisions and otherwise resolving an accessible descendant in the repository lineage.

Third, it reconstructs the task using a three-level escalation strategy. Level 1, Patch Reversal, handles cases where the historical patch still maps cleanly to modern code. Level 2, Code Mapping, is used when files, symbols, or APIs have moved but correspondence can still be established. Level 3, Agent Reconstruction, is invoked when direct mapping is too weak and an agent must re-create the change in the modern repository. This staged design is sensible: use the cheapest and most deterministic reconstruction first, and escalate only when repository evolution breaks direct transfer.

Fourth, the system validates the full lifecycle. Healthy, task, and restored states must satisfy their respective checks, and the task is verified for provenance, behavior, scope, and restoration. Objectives are expressed through task adapters, which define the expected output, executable oracle, and edit scope for task types such as Bug Fix, Feature Addition, Test Generation, API Migration, and Security Repair. That adapter abstraction makes the framework broader than a bug-fix-only benchmark generator.e9:T4f6,The evaluation focuses on reconstruction yield, fidelity, agreement with historical tasks, and environment-efficiency gains. From 1,130 eligible changes, the system finalizes 900 paired tasks, which is a strong yield given the validation requirements. On 621 matched Bug Fix candidates, Change2Task reconstructs 500 tasks, compared with 387 for SWE-smith PR Mirror, indicating better coverage when transferring historical changes to modern code.

For quality, the corpus reaches 0.894 task-weighted source change profile fidelity, measuring how well the reconstructed task preserves the original PR’s change scope and structure. More importantly, matched agent evaluation shows up to 98.0% outcome agreement between historical and reconstructed cases while preserving agent ranking. That means the reconstructed tasks are not merely superficially similar; they behave similarly enough to maintain comparative evaluation signals.

On efficiency, reusing 388 modern bases reduces environment time by 58.4%, storage by 71.2%, and end-to-end expenditure by 10.8%. One useful systems takeaway is that storage and setup savings are large, but total cost drops less dramatically, implying that validation, orchestration, and rollout execution remain substantial contributors.ea:T42b,For a quick pass, start with the introduction and the lifecycle formalization in the methodology. 第一部分是白盒表示分析。作者沿用 refusal direction 这条线：从 harmful 与 benign 请求诱发的隐藏状态差异中提取一个 refusal-related direction，用投影分数衡量模型内部“拒绝特征”的强弱。然后做 component-level ablation，把 agent 输入拆成不同组成部分，检查哪些部分最显著地破坏 harmful-benign separability。结果显示，tool specifications 是主要来源。

更关键的是，作者进一步把“工具描述的语义内容”和“工具描述的表示形式”分开。控制实验里，保留相同工具语义，但把 schema-formatted specification 改写成 flattened textual form， harmful-benign 的可分性大幅恢复；反过来，去掉工具语义但保留 schema 风格表示，退化仍然存在。这个设计很重要，因为它把问题从“工具本身危险”收缩到“schema 表示干扰了拒绝机制”。

在机制层面，作者定义了 Schema Direction：同一工具规格在 schema 格式与扁平文本格式下诱发的平均隐藏状态变化。随后比较它与 chatbot setting 下提取的 refusal direction 的夹角关系。对 harmful 请求，这个 schema direction 在多层上都与 refusal direction 负对齐，说明 schema 格式把内部状态往“远离拒绝”的方向推。作者还看了生成开始后的第一个 token，发现 schema 格式会显著减弱 refusal direction 上 harmful 与 benign 的分离度。最后用 activation steering 沿着反 schema direction 干预，观察到 harmful tool execution 减少、refusal 增加，给出一定因果证据。

第二部分是 SafeKeep。它的设计很朴素，但抓住了上面的机制：把 safety judgment 和 tool execution 解耦。具体流程是，先用 flattened textual tool specifications 做一次安全判断，避免 schema 表示对 refusal 的干扰；如果请求被判定安全，再把原始 schema-formatted specs 送回 agent pipeline 做工具选择与执行；如果不安全，则阻断工具执行并转到拒答。这个方案不需要改模型参数，也不需要访问激活，因此既可用于开源模型，也可用于闭源 API 模型。论文还做了一个关键对照：如果安全判断阶段仍保留 schema-formatted specs，仅仅多加一道 safety gate，并不能得到同样收益，说明提升确实来自表示形式的改变，而不是“多了一层审查”。ef:Ta35,The paper has two stages: identify the source of degradation, then mitigate it without changing model weights.

The first stage is white-box representation analysis. Building on prior work on refusal directions, the authors extract a refusal-related direction from hidden-state differences between harmful and benign requests. They then use projections onto this direction as a diagnostic for how strongly refusal-related features are present internally. With component-level ablations of the agent input, they show that tool specifications account for most of the safety degradation.

The crucial step is separating tool semantics from tool representation. In controlled experiments, they keep the same tool meaning but rewrite schema-formatted specifications into flattened textual descriptions; harmful–benign separability is largely restored. Conversely, when they remove tool semantics but keep the schema-style representation, degradation remains. This isolates the representational format, not just the semantic content, as the main culprit.

To explain the mechanism, they define the Schema Direction: the average hidden-state shift induced by presenting the same tool specification in schema form rather than flattened text. They compare this direction with the refusal direction extracted from chatbot behavior. For harmful requests, the schema direction is negatively aligned with the refusal direction across layers, meaning schema formatting pushes activations away from refusal-related regions. They also show that the effect persists into decoding: at the first generated token, schema formatting reduces harmful–benign separation along the refusal direction. Finally, activation steering against the schema direction reduces harmful tool execution and increases refusal, which provides causal support.

The second stage is SafeKeep. The design follows directly from the mechanism. SafeKeep decouples safety judgment from tool execution. It first evaluates the request using flattened textual tool specifications, avoiding the schema representation that interferes with refusal. If the request is judged safe, it is passed to the original agent pipeline with the original schema-formatted tool specs for tool selection and execution. If unsafe, tool execution is blocked and the model is redirected to refusal. The method requires no parameter updates and no access to activations, so it can be applied to both open and closed models. A key control baseline shows that simply adding a safety gate is not enough; if the safety stage still uses schema-formatted specs, the gains are much smaller.f0:T5ac,The evaluation covers two safety settings: direct harmful requests and observation-level prompt injection. The paper tests four LLMs in both white-box and black-box scenarios.

Three headline numbers matter most:
1. On harmful requests, the average refusal rate rises from 23.8% to 70.6%.
2. On prompt injection, the overall attack success rate drops from 25.6% to 2.5%.
3. Task-handling capability is largely preserved, so the method does not simply become unusably conservative.

The most convincing evidence, however, comes from the controlled analyses rather than the final benchmark scores:
- chatbot vs agent separability along refusal-related features, establishing the safety gap;
- component ablations of agent context, identifying tool specifications as the main source;
- same semantics / different format and same format / reduced semantics controls, separating semantic from representational effects;
- alignment analysis between schema direction and refusal direction, showing systematic negative alignment;
- first-token decoding analysis, showing that the effect survives into generation;
- activation steering, providing causal support;
- SafeKeep vs a baseline that still uses schema-formatted specs during safety judgment, showing that the benefit comes from changing the representation used for safety assessment.

The paper’s empirical strength comes from this full chain of evidence: locate, explain, intervene, and re-evaluate.f1:T5ca,A good skim is to read it in three passes: phenomenon, mechanism, mitigation.

First, read the introduction and the section that localizes the source of degradation. Second, focus on two experimental blocks:

These are the sections that determine whether the paper has identified a real mechanism rather than a loose correlation.

A 25–35 minute skim should be enough to extract the main idea and evidence. For deeper reading, three follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether the effect is specific to current function-calling schemas or general to structured protocols; whether flattened text hurts tool selection when the tool set is large; and whether this kind of schema-robust refusal preservation can be moved into training rather than handled only at inference.f2:T4d0,SESA (Self-Evolving Skill-Augmented Agent) integrates tool-augmented search self-play with an evolving skill memory.
- Two policies: a challenger/proposer generates problems with verifiable targets; a solver uses a search tool to answer. Parameters are separated.
- Skill memory B: a bounded, non-parametric bank of human-readable skills. Each entry stores a description, trigger conditions, avoidance cues (common confusions/anti-patterns), reusable query templates, and usage statistics (retrieval/helpful/hurt counts) for maintenance.
- Asymmetric access: only the solver can retrieve skills; the challenger cannot, preventing strategy leakage that would collapse the self-play game.
- Four-stage loop: (1) memory priming with a small initial set; (2) asymmetric self-play where retrieval is active during training rollouts; (3) frontier shaping to keep generated problems near the solver’s competence boundary; (4) failure distillation that converts informative failed rollouts into deduplicated skills written back to memory.
- Attribution design: compare SSP baseline, SESA-Off (trained with the loop but memory disabled at inference to measure parametric carryover), and SESA-On (memory enabled to include retrieval gains).f3:T5fb,The model uses a 397B-A17B Qwen mixture-of-experts backbone. The observation is a screenshot, and the action space is native keyboard and mouse control. For long-horizon interaction, Qwen-CUA keeps 20 recent screenshots active and folds older screenshots into fixed-size blocks of ten. This preserves recent visual evidence while keeping the prompt prefix stable enough for KV-cache reuse. The rollout infrastructure runs on an Alibaba Cloud ECS fleet with access to nearly 100,000 vCPUs and tens of thousands of concurrent environments. The environment pool includes controllable mock web services, everyday desktop applications, long-tail applications, and professional software. First, agentic RL trains autonomous search behaviors such as planning, iterative retrieval, and evidence-based reasoning over dynamic environments. Second, cross-domain hybrid OPD is applied: large corpora are built for four domains—mathematics, coding, logical reasoning, and science—combining public benchmarks with internally curated or synthesized data; domain-specific expert teachers are trained on these corpora; then those teachers distill into the search-specialized model via on-policy distillation, transferring broad reasoning and knowledge capabilities while preserving the learned search policy. The design intentionally avoids naive post-RL SFT on generic data, which risks overwriting the search policy, and instead uses multi-expert OPD on states visited by the student.f5:T46e,The attack is BCBI, or Boundary-Conditioned Backdoor Injection. The adversary fine-tunes a victim model and deploys selected agents with the poisoned version. Poisoned agents emit plausible evidence cues; each cue is insufficient alone, while cues from distinct peers jointly indicate that the hidden activation threshold has been reached. BCBI constructs counterfactual boundary pairs where task, role, round, and surrounding context are matched, but peer evidence moves from just below to just above the threshold. The output objective prefers benign behavior before the boundary and the adversarial target after it. A latent-space constraint organizes intermediate evidence states according to progression toward activation, making the transition sharper. The defense, LATTE, uses only clean interactions. It models hidden-state changes between adjacent communication rounds, learns a low-rank subspace of normal latent transitions, and screens each update before the response is released to peers. Suspicious updates are first quarantined and then, after repeated anomalies, isolated from both communication and final aggregation.f6:T457,The main benchmark is OSWorld-MCP test_all_no_internet with 309 tasks, five greedy runs per setting, and max_steps=50. With the same tools and harness, MCP improves Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking by +4.0 percentage points but degrades Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct by -5.9 percentage points, both beyond 2 standard errors. The non-reasoning model often ignores tools, emits invalid tool names, or terminates incorrectly around tools. The reasoning model avoids many of these failures, but still calls a tool on only 55 of 309 tasks, covering 23.9% of tool-reachable tasks. On VLC, where 16 of 17 tasks are tool-reachable, it never calls a tool. An RL probe with a dense post-normalization bonus increases tool adoption by roughly an order of magnitude and survives greedy decoding, but held-out accuracy does not improve. This suggests the reward reaches the tool-choice policy but not tool competence. A context-level probe shows that the screenshot after a successful tool call is often redundant; retraining with the deployment-time observation rule yields a half-cost operating point without out-of-distribution accuracy loss.f7:T4e4,The method treats a trace as system context, user request, event sequence, final output, and metadata. Events may include messages, reasoning summaries, tool calls, outputs, exceptions, state updates, and human approvals. Compilation is performed over an unsupervised intent cluster rather than a single trajectory, because a single trajectory mixes reusable procedure with one agent’s search behavior. The key technical rule is argument-level dependency verification: an edge from call a to call b is retained only when an argument of b consumes a value uniquely attributable to a. The compiler scans non-adjacent producers, records explicit evidence tuples, and abstains when alternative origins cannot be excluded. The emitted workflow contains typed nodes such as START/END, TOOL, TRANSFORM, DECISION, LLM, and HUMAN, plus control-flow edges, parameter bindings, guards, and schemas. Bindings are classified as literals, workflow inputs, prior outputs, deterministic transforms, or LLM results. A HUMAN node is reserved for unresolved values before irreversible external actions. The design also specifies build-time injection of stable user context, but the visible content states that this feature is not exercised in the reported case studies.f8:T5e9,The method has three main components. First is the milestone-plan-act workflow. Instead of planning at the finest step granularity from the start, the orchestrator first decomposes a complex query into milestones. This reduces low-level execution noise and gives the policy a more stable state abstraction. Within each milestone, it builds a dependency-aware execution graph and can run independent steps in parallel across executors. Second is explicit executor profiling. Each executor comes with textual descriptions of capability and cost, so the orchestrator reasons jointly over task requirements and executor profiles rather than routing by query features alone. This differs from standard learned routers that often rely on shallow signals and fixed executor sets. Third is end-to-end RL with tree-structured rollout. Starting from an initial trajectory, the system expands selected milestone or plan nodes into alternative branches, producing multiple strategies under comparable contexts. Rewards combine task correctness, execution efficiency, and trajectory completeness. The completeness term is important because otherwise the policy may exploit partial execution or early stopping. Rewards are normalized at both node and query levels to make signals more comparable across branches and tasks and to reduce variance. Compared with standard single-trajectory RL, this branch-based exploration gives denser supervision around local decision points and is better aligned with multi-step orchestration.f9:T407,The experiments cover three task families: mathematical reasoning, embodied decision making, and deep research. The main claim is consistent improvement on the performance-efficiency frontier over prior agentic baselines. The key result is not simply higher success rate, but better task completion at the same or lower cost, or lower executor cost at comparable performance. The paper also emphasizes generalization to unseen executors, which is more informative than evaluations on a fixed executor pool. The provided full-content excerpt does not include the final tables with exact numbers, model sizes, training steps, or cost reductions, so it would be unsafe to invent precise metrics. Still, the experimental structure makes clear what to inspect: how efficiency is measured, whether cost is token-based or latency-based, how deep the rollout tree goes, whether reward normalization stabilizes training, and what “unseen executor” means operationally—new profiles, swapped capabilities, or newly introduced executors.fa:T4ed,Argus structures a long campaign as a sequence of bounded missions over a durable project state. Four model-driven roles split authority: a Manager anchors intent and campaign state, a Planner selects the next unit of work, an Engineer implements and evaluates it, and a Reviewer independently inspects artifacts before issuing completion verdicts; low-risk tasks may use recorded Engineer self-review. These roles operate across three planes—control, execution, and records—so scheduling, execution, and bookkeeping stay separable. The working contract is written explicitly as K_t=(ι, o_t, c_t, v_t), where ι is the invariant user intent, o_t the current operational objective, c_t the constraints, and v_t the verification criteria. Material updates to the objective, constraints, or verifier require evidence, admission by the authorized role, and durable logging; an accepted update counts as compounding only when it reduces future task risk or cost. The mechanism is called verification-gated fixed-model runtime self-evolution: model parameters stay fixed, but later missions start from an evolved search policy with retained routes, measurements, verdicts, reusable skills, verifiers, and routing decisions rather than merely a longer transcript.fb:T48c,The audit performs training-free interventions exactly at the relay boundary of released systems. Cache geometry (layer count, sequence length, dtype) is held fixed across arms, and only the content is replaced. Six arms are defined: True (cache from the paired example), Deranged (cache from a different example in the same batch via a fixed-point-free permutation, preserving the marginal cache distribution exactly), Zero (all entries zeroed), Random (Gaussian entries moment-matched per example, layer, and K/V tensor to the true cache), Intact-no-private (sender processes the example with private facts replaced by irrelevant counterparts, used only in the calibrated regime), and Direct-text reference (private information passed verbatim to the receiver). Tasks are split into two regimes: a calibrated regime with procedurally generated sender-private facts unrecoverable by the receiver, and a natural regime using standard benchmarks (GSM8K, ARC-Challenge, MedQA) where the receiver can solve alone. The key contrast is True minus Deranged — the "example-pairing term" — which is the necessary condition for the "latent content is used" attribution.fc:T4f1,In the calibrated regime, across five checkpoints from three model families (Qwen3-4B/8B/14B, Mistral-Nemo-12B, phi-4) and a prose counterfactual QA surface, the True arm reaches near 100% accuracy versus 23–25% for Deranged / answer-irrelevant arms, showing the audit instrument reads at ceiling where it should. In the natural regime, under a pre-registered five-seed protocol with Holm-corrected equivalence testing, the True-versus-Deranged gap is bounded within ±2.8 points (a margin anchored to the audited system's own reported gain) on GSM8K and ARC-Challenge across three Qwen3 scales, and on MedQA at 8B; only one cell shows a small detected advantage inside the margin, and a second model family shows no detected pairing advantage at all. Notably, in one natural-regime cell the Zero arm trails True by 14.7 points while Deranged is indistinguishable from True — meaning there is a generic benefit from having any cache, but no example-specific content transfer. 正常训练，得到完整 merge 树和一批按 merge 顺序生成的 token。这里没有改 BPE 的核心学习规则，也没有在训练时引入额外目标。第二步，训练完成后，用 fully encoded corpus 统计每个 learned token 的 final exposure，也就是在最终编码结果里它真正作为输出 token 出现的频次，而不是它在 merge 过程中被使用的次数。作者据此把 token 分成两类：可见 token 和 internal-only token。低 exposure token 仍保留在 merge 树里，继续作为内部构造节点参与更长 token 的形成，但不再分配给模型可见词表 ID。第三步，为了保持目标可见词表大小不变，作者继续在原 BPE 训练基础上 resumed training，训练到超过原目标词表大小，从后续候选 merge 中挑选 树的构造能力，但把模型接口限制在重新筛选后的可见词表上。论文强调这不是普通 vocabulary pruning，因为词表大小不变，merge 顺序也尽量保持；变化的是哪些 token 对模型可见。\n\n从方法取舍看，这个设计比“直接按频次删 token”更稳，因为它不破坏更长 token 的生成路径；也比“重新训练一个更大的 tokenizer 再截断”更可控，因为它显式区分了构造节点和可见节点。作者还做了 vocabulary-only evaluation，用共享的 exact minimum-token objective 去剥离 native BPE merge-order frequent longer units, while the language model only cares about the final emitted tokens. Many learned merge tokens are useful only as intermediate nodes in the merge tree and rarely survive in the fully encoded corpus. Standard BPE still exposes all of them to the model-visible vocabulary, which wastes scarce vocabulary slots on low-exposure tokens that receive little direct training signal. The paper asks a narrower and more practical question than vocabulary compression: with the visible vocabulary size fixed, can we decouple merge construction from model-visible token selection and reallocate those slots to tokens that are actually emitted?","importance":"This is a tokenizer paper with direct relevance to pretraining efficiency and vocabulary design. Its main contribution is conceptual but practical: BPE merge learning and visible vocabulary exposure do not need to be the same object. That matters because tokenizer choices affect sequence length, embedding utilization, multilingual coverage, and how well token embeddings are trained. The motivation is especially plausible for byte-level BPE on UTF-8 text, where non-Latin scripts can generate many byte fragments that are necessary for building characters or words but are poor model-facing units. If the empirical results hold, the method offers a low-friction improvement path: no change to the LM architecture, no change to the core BPE training loop, only a post-training visibility filter plus slot reallocation. Each expert sees a router-selected, gate-weighted token subset whose distribution changes during training. The main practical claim is that the optimal batch-size schedule depends on total budget and the shape of the learning-rate schedule, but is largely independent of peak learning rate, weight decay, model size, architecture, and optimizer. If this continues to hold at larger scale, hyperparameter transfer becomes simpler: scale learning rate and weight decay with the training horizon, then generate the batch-size schedule analytically instead of retuning it for every run.","technical_approach":"The method starts from stochastic convex optimization and uses it as an approximation to neural-network training dynamics. The authors derive a sequence-to-sequence characterization that maps an arbitrary learning-rate sequence and batch-size sequence to a predicted loss sequence at any iteration. Batch size enters through the stochastic-gradient noise term: larger batches reduce sampling noise, but under a fixed data or compute budget they also change the allocation of optimization effort. The final-iteration loss is then minimized over the whole batch-size sequence under a budget constraint. Solving this constrained problem gives a closed-form schedule. The key distinction from fixed-batch training or hand-designed schedules is that the allocation is driven by the marginal effect of each training step under the chosen learning-rate shape, not by a separately tuned batch-size constant.","experiments":"The empirical coverage includes pretraining and fine-tuning settings, dense Llama3-style models, Qwen3 MoE models, and vision-language models up to 7B parameters. The optimizers include AdamW and Muon. The reported results support three claims. First, the loss prediction from learning-rate and batch-size sequences remains accurate beyond the convex SGD setting, including non-convex models and adaptive optimizers. Second, the joint scaling recipe improves compute efficiency by roughly 6% to 15% over static batch-size baselines with no extra training computation. The recipe combines 1/sqrt(T) scaling for learning rate and weight decay with the derived scale-free batch-size schedule. Third, the schedule preserves universal training dynamics, referred to as supercollapse, suggesting that the gain is compatible with cross-scale hyperparameter transfer rather than being a local tuning artifact.","reading_guide":"Read Sections 2 and 3 carefully. Section 2 explains how batch size is incorporated as a gradient-noise control variable in the loss-sequence predictor. Section 3, especially Theorem 3, contains the main result: the closed-form optimal batch-size schedule and the reason peak learning rate drops out. Section 7 is useful for checking the proof assumptions and the empirical extension beyond SGD. Section 9 is the main evidence section; focus on the ablations across pretraining, fine-tuning, dense models, MoE models, VLMs, AdamW, and Muon. Section 11 can be skimmed to compare the proposed schedule with batch-size practices in recent LLM training. Two points deserve deeper follow-up: whether the same rule holds at much longer horizons and whether data-mixture changes, curriculum, annealing, or cooldown phases should be included in the budget model.","authors_note":""},"recommendation":{"zh":"应立刻看推导假设和实验控制；若 token budget 干净，动态 batch schedule 值得进内部预训练 ablation。","en":"Read the assumptions and controls first; if the token budget is clean, dynamic batch scheduling deserves an internal pretraining ablation."},"metadata":{"institutions":[],"authors":["Jiaxiang Li","Zhiqi Bu","Shiyun Xu"],"notable_authors":[],"tags":["scaling-laws","batch-size-schedule","learning-rate","compute-allocation","training-dynamics"],"links":{"arxiv":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27731","pdf":"https://arxiv.org/pdf/2607.27731","github":null,"project":null,"source_url":null,"article":null}}},{"id":"2607.28611","title":"Chimera: Designing and Chinchilla-Scaling Hybrid Visual Diffusion Transformers","abstract":"Visual generation increasingly requires high-resolution images, long videos, and multimodal context, making the quadratic cost of full attention prohibitive. language models: long-term memory and reasoning are stored in the same parameter set. Increasing knowledge capacity usually means scaling the whole backbone or continuing to train all parameters, which is expensive and can cause forgetting or unintended capability shifts. Memory Decoder separates long-term memory into a pretrained, swappable parametric module. This work tests whether that idea still works at a more realistic pretraining scale: up to 6.9B memory parameters and 300B training tokens.","importance":"The main value for pretraining research is the parameter-allocation result. The paper provides evidence that, under a comparable parameter budget, assigning parameters to an independently trained memory can be more efficient than putting all additional parameters into the backbone. This has direct implications for continual pretraining, domain adaptation, and modular language models. Domain knowledge can be trained as a separate memory and swapped at inference while the base model remains frozen. The contribution is not only architectural; it also shows how to build the kNN teacher distributions at 207B-token scale. A caveat is that the memory is trained from a non-parametric kNN teacher, so the offline indexing and search cost is substantial. The result should be read as a credible path for decoupling knowledge capacity from reasoning capacity, not as a cost-free replacement for backbone scaling.","technical_approach":"The method combines a frozen base LM with a separately pretrained parametric memory. At inference, both modules process the same context and produce next-token distributions. The final prediction is an interpolation: p_final = (1 - alpha) p_theta + alpha p_mem. The memory is trained to imitate a kNN-LM distribution while retaining a standard next-token objective. The loss shown in the paper is beta KL + (1 - beta) CE: the KL term aligns the memory with the non-parametric retriever distribution, and the CE term preserves direct language-modeling supervision. Compared with RAG, the approach does not retrieve external passages at inference. Compared with kNN-LM, it compresses the retrieval distribution into parameters. The scaling work is enabled by a distributed Faiss pipeline with embedding compression, index sharding, and parallel search. For general memory pretraining, sparse kNN distribution storage and distributed streaming are used so that each batch only loads the required distribution entries.","experiments":"The largest general memory has 6.9B parameters and is pretrained on 300B tokens. The paper aims to enable strictly end-to-end generative modeling—training-time sampling matches inference-time sampling—without sacrificing the ability to represent multimodal distributions.","importance":"It introduces “exploration” as a scalable third axis for pretraining, alongside parameters and data. When the same Transformer block is reused across recurrent depth, additive reinjection of an input-conditioned source can make an input-conditioned reference state fail to be a fixed point. Even if the hidden state is exactly at the chosen anchor, another application of the shared transition may still produce an update. The authors call this the zero-deviation forcing bias. It can be harmless or useful within the trained loop-depth range, but it becomes a source of uncontrolled dynamics when depth is extrapolated at test time.","importance":"The relevance is architectural and dynamical rather than data-centric. Looped Transformers expose depth as a reusable compute axis: effective depth can grow without adding a separate parameter set for every layer. That connects to adaptive compute, latent reasoning, and algorithmic generalization. The useful contribution is the formulation of a hidden degree of freedom that ordinary residual/source injection creates under parameter sharing. In non-shared Transformers, different layers can absorb such effects locally. In a recurrently shared block, the same effect becomes a repeated forcing term, so fixed-point behavior and trajectory consistency matter.","technical_approach":"Source-Centered State Evolution, or SCSE, reparameterizes the recurrent computation around a learned input-conditioned anchor h*(e). Instead of evolving the absolute hidden state directly, it evolves the deviation Δ_t = h_t - h*(e). The one-step map in these coordinates is T_t(Δ; e), and its value at zero deviation, b_t(e)=T_t(0;e), measures the forcing bias at the anchor. Standard additive looped Transformers do not constrain this quantity. SCSE constructs a zero-preserving recurrent core and uses a mask so that the zero-deviation boundary is exact, giving T_t(0;e)=0 by construction. Input dependence is retained through the anchor and the initial deviation; recurrent computation is driven by off-anchor state. The resulting heads behave like implicit sliding-window heads, and the softmax distribution is also renormalized over the remaining visible tokens. 用 mixture 方式提高翻译容量。\n\n论文还提出了两个误差来源：\n1. propagation error：如果在较早层就开始翻译，翻译误差会沿目标模型后续层不断传播放大；\n2. correction-deficit error：如果在太晚的层才接入翻译后的 cache，目标模型剩余层数太少，来不及把误差纠正回来。\n\n作者用这个分析解释了为什么翻译层位置会出现 U obse","starred":false,"priority":"p3","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-07-31T16:16:45Z","category_id":"efficient","cover_url":"/covers/2607_29591.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是长上下文推理里的一个很具体但很核心的问题：在固定 Existing methods mostly treat this as a pure selection problem: under a fixed budget, keep the most important original KV pairs. The paper argues that this formulation breaks down under aggressive compression. verifier、审计或蒸馏信号时。","technical_approach":"方法核心是 controlled fixed-trace replay。标准 end-to-end 压缩评测里，压缩会同时影响中间推理内容的生成和后续答案，因此很难分辨到底是“模型没想出来”还是“已经写出来的推理在压缩后不可用了”。作者的做法是先让 Full-KV 模型在无压缩条件下生成完整 reasoning trace，然后把 question 和这段固定的 textual trace 一起 prefill 进去，只压缩 trace 对应的 KV cache，保护 question cache 不动，再从 </think> 之后继续解码答案。这样所有方法看到的文本推理内容完全相同，差异只来自压缩后的 KV 表示是否还能让模型有效利用这些已有推理。\n\n围绕这个协议，作者设计了三类指标。第一是 final-answer accuracy，仍然保留传统指标。第二是 answer–chain consistency，用来测最终答案是否与可见推理链条一致。第三是 perturbation faithfulness，通过对中间推理做受控扰动，观察压缩模型是否仍然对支持性或误导性中间信息表现出合理敏感性。作者强调，这里区分的是行为功能，而不是声称 KV 里存在物理上分离的“答案子空间”和“证据子空间”。\n\n实验覆盖十种 token-eviction 类 KV 压缩方法和一种 quantization 方法，跨三个模型、多个任务和不同压缩预算。任务包括数学推理、科学问答、临床计算和长上下文检索。作者还补充了 end-to-end 结果，说明 fixed-trace replay 发现的模式并不是纯实验室产物，而是在真实生成里也能看到。和已有 KV compression 论文相比，这篇文章的区别不在提出新压缩算法，而在于指出 accuracy-only evaluation 的系统性盲点，并给出更细粒度的诊断框架。","experiments":"从全文给出的结果描述看，最重要的发现不是某个方法赢了多少，而是不同指标之间的分叉。作者在 AIME、GPQA-Diamond、MedCalc 这类 reasoning-heavy 任务上观察到：在一定压缩预算下，若只看 final accuracy，一些方法仍然显得“保持得不错”；但 answer–chain consistency 和 perturbation faithfulness 会更早、更明显地下滑。这说明压缩后的模型可能还能沿着残留的答案线索给出正确结论，却已经不能稳定地利用或维护支撑该结论的推理证据。换句话说，accuracy 在这里是非对称诊断：一旦 accuracy 崩了，当然说明压缩伤害很大；但 accuracy 没崩，并不代表 reasoning state 仍然健康。\n\n另一个关键结果是任务依赖性。RULER QA 这类长上下文检索任务中，答案更直接依赖保留精确证据，因此压缩造成的损伤更容易直接反映到 accuracy collapse 上，answer–evidence gap 相对没那么隐蔽。相反，在数学、科学 QA、临床计算这类任务里，模型可能依靠结论邻近 cue、局部 summary 或其他 answer-like signals 保住最终答案，但推理链条的可审计性已经下降。\n\n作者还比较了多种 token eviction 方法和一种 quantization 方法，并在不同模型家族上重复实验，结论是这种 gap 不是单一算法或单一模型的偶然现象，而是一个较普遍的评测问题。摘要里没有给出完整数字表，但从正文结构看，Table 2 提供了 end-to-end 结果，主文其余表格则展示不同预算、任务和方法下 accuracy、consistency、faithfulness 三轴的分离情况。阅读时应重点关注这些曲线是否在相同 budget Each committed token is tagged with the hidden state that the verifier has already computed. Later, at every generation position, the current hidden state queries past positions in the same pool, and the retrieved neighbors provide candidate continuations. Two design choices matter. First, the query is performed per position rather than once per request, which lets the method recover after local novel tokens such as identifiers or names. Second, semantic continuations are merged into the same multi-source attention tree used by lexical drafters, instead of choosing one source over another. The training objective minimizes post-W_O attention-output error through the actual INT2 quantization and attention path. The method first applies an attention-equivalent key reparameterization: centering the keys shifts all logits for a given query by the same constant and therefore leaves the softmax distribution unchanged, while reducing the dynamic range exposed to INT2 quantization. It then decomposes the post-W_O output error into key-induced and value-induced terms. The key rotation is optimized before the value rotation because quantized keys determine the attention probabilities used to aggregate values. The learned rotations are fixed at inference time. Independent token, sentence, or chunk selection can keep a relevant fragment while removing the antecedent, entity definition, or bridge fact needed to interpret it. The authors call this failure referential dangling.","importance":"The result matters for long-context inference and cost reduction. Many compressors optimize local relevance, perplexity, embedding similarity, attention-derived importance, or learned salience. Multi-hop reasoning instead requires a closed evidence path. A compressed prompt can contain the answer string and still be unusable because the dependency that links the query to that answer has been removed. This is a useful diagnostic for pretraining and inference research around long context: recall of relevant spans is not enough; dependency completeness should be measured.","technical_approach":"The work formalizes extractive hard compression as selecting a source-ordered subset of the input under a token budget. The empirical study starts with Beaver, a chunk-ranking compressor using Qwen3-0.6B embeddings, and then checks whether the issue generalizes to other compressors. Two repair strategies are studied. The first is annotation-guided reselection: reinsert the omitted supporting paragraph and remove the lowest-scoring non-supporting paragraphs to keep the token budget fixed. The second is automatic restoration: generate candidate sentences from omitted text and train a compact classifier to rank whether a candidate is needed to interpret retained content, then reinsert top-ranked candidates without using support annotations at inference time.","experiments":"At a 0.30 compression ratio, Beaver leaves answer paths incomplete in 34% to 54% of bridge examples across HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue. 说完成了但实际失败的轨迹。这比单纯报告 judge accuracy 更有用，因为它解释了为什么用弱 judge 做自动筛选或 RL 可能把模型推向“会表演完成”的策略。","technical_approach":"论文构建了 OSReward，用专门搭建的跨平台环境生成和标注轨迹，而不是直接复用已有 benchmark 的离线轨迹。环境覆盖 images,","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-05-20T00:25:52Z","category_id":"eval","cover_url":"/covers/2607_28640.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL","cs.CV"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作要解决的问题很明确：多模态大模型在面对语义等价、但呈现模态不同的输入时，预测并不稳定。具体说，同一句题目里把“可视觉化的概念”从文字换成对应图片后，模型常常从答对变成答错。作者把这种现象定义为 modality gap，并把它从一个零散观察变成了可系统测量、可训练干预的问题。关键不在于模型会不会看图，而在于模型是否真正学到了“语义跨模态不变性”：同一概念以文本 token 或视觉 token 出现时，后续推理链条应尽量一致。对 MLLM 预训练来说，这是比传统 VQA 准确率更基础的能力约束。","importance":"对基座研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它提出了一个比常规图文 benchmark 更贴近统一建模目标的诊断维度：不是测“图像是否提供额外信息”，而是测“图像替换文本后语义是否保持”。这直接对应 native multimodal pretraining 是否真的把不同模态映射到兼容表示空间。第二，作者给出的结果说明，modality gap 在 42 个模型上普遍存在，平均掉点 19.6%，而且单靠更大训练算力、CoT、few-shot 都很难补上，这说明问题更像训练目标和数据分布错配，而不是提示词技巧不足。第三，作者进一步证明可以在 pre-training 和 post-training 两个阶段用 TokenSwap 数据增强来缩小 gap，且不明显伤害文本能力和常规视觉语言能力。这一点对数据配比、跨模态 curriculum、以及 post-train 是否能修补 pretrain 缺口，都有直接启发。","technical_approach":"方法核心是 TokenSwap：从纯文本样本中找出可视觉化、且对任务有贡献的概念，把这些概念替换成语义对齐的自然图像，形成 image-interleaved 输入。它不是把整段文字渲染成图片，也不是构造传统图文问答，而是在 token/phrase 粒度做替换，尽量保持原始句法结构、上下文和推理负担不变。这样做的好处是控制变量更干净：文本版和多模态版之间，唯一主要变化就是某些语义单元从文字 token 变成视觉 token。\n\n构建 TokenSwap-Bench 时，作者以 MMLU 为底座，经过三步处理。第一步，用 Gemini-2.0-Flash 识别题目和选项中可视觉化的概念，通常是具体实体或视觉可落地的短语。第二步，用文生图模型为每个概念生成对应图像。第三步，做一套比较严格的过滤，避免 benchmark 测到的是图像生成噪声而不是模态差异。这里有几个过滤点比较关键：\n1. 图像忠实性验证：检查生成图像是否真的表达了目标概念，且在当前语境下不改变原意。\n2. 任务相关性验证：把被替换概念从原文本里删掉，若模型性能不受影响，则说明这些概念并不关键，这类样本会被过滤掉。这样可以避免“替了也无所谓”的伪 gap。\n3. 语义可恢复性验证：对替换后的图像做 caption，再把 caption 填回文本，检查是否能恢复原语义，尽量保证视觉替换不是不可逆的信息损失。\n\n训练干预部分，作者不是提出新架构，而是提出一种数据增强思路：把 text-only 数据和 image-interleaved 对应样本一起用于训练。论文强调这种增强既可用于 pre-training，也可用于 post-training。它背后的假设很朴素：如果模型在训练中反复看到“同一语义内容以文本和视觉两种 token 形式出现”，就会被迫学习更稳定的跨模态表示与推理路径。相比只靠图文对齐 loss 或 caption-style 数据，这种做法更直接地监督“替换不变性”。","experiments":"实验最重要的结论有四个。\n\n第一，modality gap 普遍且幅度不小。作者在 42 个 MLLM 上测试，文本输入换成 image-interleaved 输入后，性能下降范围是 4.2% 到 47.4%，平均下降 19.6%，并给出 ±3.3% 的 95% 置信区间。这个量级已经不是边角误差，而是会系统影响多模态推理可靠性的缺口。\n\n第二，reasoning-oriented 模型 gap 明显更小。文中报告 reasoning 模型平均 gap 约 10.1%，非 reasoning 模型约 25.5%。这说明较小的 gap 可能不是来自推理提示词，而是来自训练阶段的特殊机制，比如更强的中间过程监督、更多跨模态 reasoning 数据、或更强调一致性的后训练配方。\n\n第三，常见 prompting 手段帮助有限。无论是 chain-of-thought 还是 few-shot，都不能稳定缩小 gap。这个结果很重要，因为它把问题从“推理时没想清楚”转回“表示层和训练分布没对齐”。\n\n第四，单纯扩大训练算力收益很弱。作者提到训练 FLOPs 增加 10 倍，gap 只大约缩小 2.8%。这说明 scaling 对这个问题不是主解，至少在现有数据和目标下，模型不会自然学到足够强的跨模态不变性。\n\n在训练增强实验里，TokenSwap 数据在 pre-training 和 post-training 两个阶段都能有效减小 modality gap，同时不牺牲 text-only 或常规 vision-language 表现，部分设置下还有轻微增益。摘要和正文片段没有给出完整表格数字，但从作者的表述看，结论不是“只在单一模型上有效”，而是具有一定普适性。阅读时应重点核对：不同模型规模、不同训练阶段、不同增强比例下，gap 缩小幅度是否稳定；以及 text-only / VL benchmark 是否真的没有明显回退。","reading_guide":"这篇更适合按“问题定义—benchmark 构造—现象分析—训练修复”四步来读。\n\n先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2。这里把问题讲得最清楚：什么叫 modality gap，为什么 TokenSwap 比把整段文本变图片更干净，以及最终 benchmark 长什么样。\n\n然后看 TokenSwap-Bench 构造细节，尤其是过滤流程。这里决定 benchmark 是否可信。重点看：概念抽取标准、图像生成质量控制、task relevance 检验、semantic recoverability 检验。如果这些环节不严，gap 可能只是替换噪声。\n\n接着看 42 个模型的大表和 reasoning vs non-reasoning 的分组结果。这里最值得深挖的是：哪些模型 gap 小，是否与训练数据、视觉 encoder、interleaved pretraining、后训练 recipe 有对应关系。若正文或附录给了按架构、机构、训练范式的拆分，建议细看。\n\n最后看训练增强实验。重点不是“能不能涨分”，而是三件事：一，pre-train 和 post-train 哪个阶段更有效；二，是否存在 text-only 能力回退；三，增强样本比例和收益是否线性。预计泛读 25–35 分钟，若要判断是否值得在自家配方里复现，过滤流程和训练实验至少要精读一遍。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper studies a specific failure mode in multimodal LLMs: they often change their prediction when semantically equivalent text spans are replaced by aligned images. The authors call this the modality gap. The key issue is not generic image understanding, but semantic invariance across modalities. If a concept appears as text tokens in one prompt and as visual tokens in another, a well-trained MLLM should preserve the same reasoning trajectory and final answer. The paper turns this from an anecdotal observation into a measurable benchmarked problem, and then asks whether training can reduce it.","importance":"Its value for pretraining research is fairly direct. First, it introduces a diagnostic that is closer to the goal of unified multimodal modeling than standard vision-language benchmarks. Instead of testing whether images add complementary information, it tests whether images can substitute text without breaking semantics. That probes whether pretraining actually learned compatible cross-modal representations. Second, the empirical result is strong enough to matter: across 42 MLLMs, the average drop is 19.6%, and neither scaling, CoT, nor few-shot prompting fixes much of it. In practice, semantically distinct criteria can be behaviorally coupled: improving performance on one criterion systematically changes scores on another, distorting aggregate scores used for model release or product iteration decisions. Existing methods either only perform semantic rubric deduplication, or diagnose coupling post hoc on already-scored data. No framework can detect such behavioral coupling before large-scale evaluation runs (preflight).","importance":"LLM post-training stages (SFT, RL alignment) rely heavily on rubric-based LLM-as-judge scoring to construct training signals and evaluate model iterations. Rubric coupling introduces bias into alignment objectives — for example, double-counting the same latent trait and misdirecting optimization. As a low-cost preflight diagnostic, RADAR can identify rubric coupling issues before large-scale evaluation runs, improving the quality of alignment training signals and making model version comparisons more reliable.","technical_approach":"RADAR is a three-stage preflight diagnostic framework that requires no human-labeled data. Stage 1: For each criterion C_i in the rubric, a generator LLM produces criterion-conditioned synthetic probe responses — samples designed to strongly satisfy or clearly violate C_i, with other criteria left unspecified. Stage 2: A verifier LLM (the LLM judge) scores all synthetic responses against the full set of rubric criteria. Stage 3: The scores are used to compute a directional coupling matrix that measures how much changing one criterion's score affects other criteria, in both direction and magnitude. Bidirectional leakage suggests potential double-counting, asymmetric leakage suggests upstream-downstream dependence, and task-specific leakage suggests distribution-sensitive coupling.","experiments":"RADAR is validated on three industry-relevant evaluation settings: NVIDIA HelpSteer2, SumPubMed, and the Yale-Salesforce SummEval benchmark. Stability analysis shows that only a few probes per criterion are needed to produce stable coupling estimates, making the method low-cost enough to audit the growing set of rubrics required by agentic systems with many sub-components and fast model release cycles.","reading_guide":"Focus on Section 2 for the method design (especially the criterion-conditioned synthetic probe approach and the definition of the directional coupling matrix), Section 3 for validation results across the three benchmarks, and the distinction between rubric-intrinsic and behavioral coupling in Section 1. Policies are enforced by native Linux mechanisms rather than by natural-language instructions. The policy space has three axes: network egress, filesystem scope, and privilege. Each axis has open, restricted, and locked postures, mapped to relevant NIST SP 800-53 control families such as boundary protection, access control, information-flow control, process isolation, and least privilege. The evaluation uses three nested levels: Control, where the agent runs as root with open network and writable filesystem; Non-root, which isolates the effect of dropping root privileges; and NIST-derived high, which combines an egress allow-list, a mostly read-only filesystem with a small writable set, and full privilege lockdown. Hardening hurts every model-harness bundle, but not uniformly. Under the strictest policy, success losses reach 18.3 percentage points and cost inflation reaches 167.3%. The model that best preserves success is also the one that loses the most efficiency, so policy changes the success-cost frontier and can change model choice. Failure decomposition attributes the additional failures mainly to budget exhaustion and completed-but-wrong solutions, with different proportions across bundles. 可以对应不同自演化组件：上下文提示、结构化记忆、可复用技能库，或更完整的 harness。\n\n框架最关键的设计是三种 streaming scenario。Isolated：每个 benchmark 各自形成独立流，经验只在域内累积；Sequential：benchmark 按固定顺序串联，前一个 benchmark 的经验会传给后一个；Interleaved：所有 benchmark 的任务打散混合成一个统一流。这个设计不是简单换数据顺序，而是在控制“经验迁移范围”和“域混合程度”两个变量。它让作者能区分：某方法在单域内有效，还是在跨域混流下仍然稳；某模型是因为基础能力强而能利用经验，还是因为方法本身设计得好。\n\n实验覆盖五类代表性自演化方法：ACE、A-Mem、ReasoningBank、AutoSkill、Harness；三种前沿基础模型：GPT-5.4、Gemini 更差，这一点有些反直觉。论文的解释是，固定顺序串联会让早期域经验以较强偏置进入后续域，形成更明显的负迁移；而 Interleaved 虽然更混，但持续交替暴露不同域，反而让检索式或记忆式方法更容易维持可用的经验分布。\n\n第二，收益受基础模型能力门控。最弱模型会出现负 evolution gain，也就是加了自演化后反而更差；中等能力模型的收益有时比更强模型更明显，说明“模型越强越能吃到 self-evolution 红利”并不成立。更合理的理解是：模型需要足够强，才能把噪声较大的自生成经验转化为有效策略；但当模型本身已很强时，外部经验机制的边际收益未必继续增加。\n\n第三，没有单一方法在所有模型和场景下都占优。context-integrated 方法更适合 Isolated 这类域内流；retrieval-based 方法在 Interleaved 这类跨域混流下更有优势。方法选择还依赖基础模型，不能假设在一个模型上有效的 evolution 机制会无缝迁移到另一个模型。\n\n从实验设计看，论文的价值在于组合评测规模，而不是某个单点分数。它把“方法是否有效”改写成“在什么模型、什么任务流结构下有效”，这比传统平均分更接近真实部署。","reading_guide":"如果只想抓主结论，先看 Introduction 里的三条发现，再看 This faithfulness-safety tradeoff has not been systematically quantified in prior work.","importance":"The work clarifies that higher faithfulness is not universally beneficial for reasoning models, and that an explicit tradeoff exists between faithfulness and safety. This has direct implications for the design of alignment objectives and training recipes for reasoning models, including RL-based alignment. The proposed Targeted Reasoning Replacement method provides a more rigorous measure of the causal link between reasoning traces and model behavior, compared to traditional prompt-hint based faithfulness evaluation. The white-box representation analysis findings also inform research on alignment mechanisms and representation steering in reasoning models.","technical_approach":"The HazMart dataset is constructed with 77 human-written scenarios across 11 harm categories, where the model acts as an AI shopkeeper interacting with the environment via function calls. Each scenario includes two equivalent safe options and one harmful option. The core evaluation method, Targeted Reasoning Replacement, does not add biasing hints to input prompts. Instead, it directly replaces key content in the model's own generated reasoning trace: references to one safe choice are swapped with references to the other safe choice (for faithfulness measurement) or to the harmful choice (for safety measurement), to test whether the model follows the modified trace. White-box probing and representation steering are also used to identify residual stream directions that control faithfulness and safety.","experiments":"Among evaluated models, QwQ-32B achieves the best safety performance, rejecting 73.88% of unsafe reasoning traces, but has a faithfulness rate of only 74.7% — it follows modified safe reasoning in 74.7% of cases. DeepSeek-R1_Llama-70B has high faithfulness, following modified safe reasoning in 97.5% of cases, but rejects only 12.3% of unsafe reasoning, essentially blindly adhering to reasoning trace conclusions. Overall, higher model faithfulness correlates with a higher probability of following unsafe reasoning. White-box analysis on QwQ-32B identifies anti-correlated residual stream directions that control reasoning compliance and resistance, respectively. At the action-commit token, the safety direction has a prediction AUROC of 0.94, and the faithfulness direction has an AUROC of 0.78. Amplifying the safety direction improves safe behavior by 9 percentage points without impairing core reasoning capabilities.","reading_guide":"Focus on the problem framing of the faithfulness-safety tension in the introduction, the design logic of Targeted Reasoning Replacement (and its differences from traditional prompt-based faithfulness evaluation), and the cross-model comparison results. 用于分类时常需要“置信度”来做 selective prediction（低置信度拒答/拒分）。但在黑盒场景下常用的 verbalization（让模型输出 0–100 的自报置信度）会产生极度稀疏的置信度取值，导致阈值选择空间很小；更隐蔽的是，这种稀疏会让 AUARC（accuracy–rejection curve 的阈值语义（阈值跨过某个离散置信度前，覆盖率/准确率不应连续变化）。作者主张标准化使用 stepwise。\n方法改进：verbalization logprobs。做法是仍让模型 verbalize 置信度数字，但不把生成的单个数字当最终值，而是用这些数字 token 下可能变成最差，说明“插值选择”足以翻转结论。\n改进效果：verbalization logprobs 在 4 个数据集上相对 vanilla verbalization 提升约 +2.3 AUARC，且无额外计算成本（不增加采样次数）。","reading_guide":"泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：\n1) estimates are needed for selective prediction (rejecting low-confidence cases). First, the CoT-guided teacher is trained to form strong latent reasoning trajectories under explicit multimodal guidance. Second, the CoT-free student is warmed up so that latent reasoning is stable before distillation. Third, on-policy latent distillation is performed: the student rolls out answers using its current policy, the teacher supervises those student-generated trajectories at the token level, and the student latent trajectory is aligned with the teacher latent trajectory. OPD samples trajectories from the current student, so supervision is applied at prefixes the student actually visits. However, sharing the same prefix does not guarantee that the complete teacher distribution is a suitable target. In VLM reasoning, teacher corrections may rely on visual evidence that a compact student cannot represent.","importance":"The main training lesson is that stronger teacher targets are not always better for smaller multimodal students. The useful signal is the part of the teacher correction that lies within the student’s current response geometry. This matters for VLM distillation, multimodal mid-training, and synthetic supervision pipelines where large models provide dense token-level targets. The paper offers a more structured alternative to simply reducing the KL weight or interpolating the teacher distribution uniformly.","technical_approach":"The method keeps the OPD protocol: the student rolls out an on-policy trajectory, and both student and teacher are evaluated on the resulting prefixes. Standard OPD minimizes a full-vocabulary token-level reverse KL to the complete teacher distribution. FP-OPD changes only the target. It represents the teacher signal as a correction to the student log-probabilities, estimates the student’s local visual response space using detached perturbation probes, and projects the teacher correction onto that space under the Fisher metric induced locally by KL. The projected correction defines a reachable target q^R, which replaces the full teacher distribution in the same reverse-KL loss. Unlike temperature scaling or uniform target weakening, the projection selectively keeps corrections that the student can express through its current visual pathway.","experiments":"A diagnostic target-scaling study shows the mismatch clearly. 的先验直接放进训练和采样过程。第二，它对统一建模范式有参考价值：如果不同子空间的信噪比演化规律不同，就不该共享完全相同的 corruption / denoising schedule。这一点不只适用于图像，也可能迁移到视频、音频离散 token、甚至某些非 AR 语言建模范式。就量级看，这不是“换个指标的小修小补”，而是在 pixel-space flow matching latent 不同，这个变换是无损的，不需要额外训练编码器。\n\n在此基础上，作者没有设计双塔或金字塔网络，而是沿用 JiT 的 pixel-space transformer，只改噪声注入和采样日程。低频带在整个 t∈[0,1] 上参与 flow matching；高频带只在 t∈[t*,1] 上参与，也就是前半段保持纯噪声，等低频已经形成较稳定的粗结构后，再把高频噪声注入并与低频通过逆小波变换合并，随后联合去噪。这样做的含义很明确：早期模型只处理 coarse structure，后期再处理 fine detail，避免在低信噪比区间浪费容量。\n\n从训练角度看，这相当于给不同频带定义不同的线性噪声日程。作者强调这不是把高频完全独立建模，而是“延迟进入、后期联合 refinement”，因此仍保留跨频带耦合。相比 latent diffusion，这个方案不需要 VAE 压缩带来的信息损失；相比标准 pixel-space flow matching，它显式利用了自然图像的频率层级；相比复杂 progressive 生成架构，它几乎不改主干网络，工程代价较低。\n\n另一个值得注意的点是评测设计。作者认为标准 FID 会把高分辨率图像下采样到 speaker similarity 两类奖励；在组内对每种奖励做标准化，再组合成一个 signed 的 group-relative advantage。这个 advantage 直接作为 flow-matching loss 的样本权重，让高于组均值的样本被强化，低于组均值的样本被抑制。这里有两个关键设计。其一，作者显式引入 group-mean reward baseline，把 reward weighting 变成 advantage weighting，目的是去掉 prompt 间 reward scale 差异，并放大同一 prompt 内细微但有意义的质量差别。其二，用 Wasserstein-2 velocity penalty 把更新后的速度场锚定到冻结的 pretrained reference，限制策略漂移，避免为了追奖励而损伤自然度或稳定性。相比 Flow-GRPO 一类方法，GROW 不需要 ODE-to-SDE 转换，不需要逐步 likelihood 估计，也不需要为每个 patch 存整条随机轨迹；因此更适合 DiTAR 这种在 AR 外环里反复调用 flow solver 的结构。论文还讨论了为什么不用纯正指数权重：在 bounded reward 且分布很窄的 TTS 场景里，指数权重对弱差异不敏感，且容易被共享的 imitation term 主导，组内标准化后的 signed advantage 更利于 credit assignment。","experiments":"实验在 LibriSpeech-PC test-clean、Seed-TTS English、Seed-TTS Chinese 三个零样本测试集上进行，目标是同时优化 WER 与 speaker similarity，并监控自然度 训练设置相近的效果，而相对 32-NFE 的 DiTAR-GRPO baseline，训练速度约快 2.9×；若在相同训练 rollout NFE 下比较，GROW 仍约快 1.1×。所有模型最终评测统一使用 32 NFE，避免把训练时采样步数差异混入测试。消融重点包括 rollout NFE、CFG、reward weighting 形式与多奖励组合方式。论文的核心经验是：组相对优势优于简单 other","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-07-31T10:19:41Z","category_id":"post_train","cover_url":"/covers/2607_29246.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.AI"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是多奖励 RL 中一个很具体、也很常见的问题：当 helpfulness、safety、correctness、tool-use success 这类奖励被先加权成一个标量再做策略优化时，不同目标会在同一步梯度里直接冲突，结果是每个目标都学得不够彻底，且对权重、尺度、奖励校准都很敏感。作者把这个现象明确命名为 multi-reward alignment tax。论文要解决的不是“如何再设计一个更好的 reward weighting”，而是换掉 reward-space composition 这个接口本身：不要先混奖励，再训一个折中策略；而是分别学每个奖励对应的正向策略，再在策略空间里组合。","importance":"对基座研究的直接意义不在 pretrain 主体，而在 pretrain↔post-train 接口。现在很多后训练问题都不是单一目标，尤其是 reasoning、tool use、safety、style control 同时存在时，reward scalarization 往往带来不稳定和性能折损。PRISM 提供了一个很清楚的替代思路：把“偏好组合”从 reward 侧移到 policy 侧，把训练时的冲突拆开，把推理时的权衡显式化。这个思路对多目标对齐、可控推理、甚至未来把不同能力头或不同 mode 合并进统一模型都有启发。贡献量级上，它更像一个有明确机制假设、并在多个设置下验证有效的后训练方法，而不是会立刻改写主流 RL recipe 的基础定律型工作。","technical_approach":"方法核心是 policy decomposition + logit-space composition。具体做法有三层。\n\n第一层，策略分解。对 N 个奖励，作者不再训练一个共享的单策略去同时最大化所有奖励，而是训练 N 个 positive policies，每个只负责一个 reward 维度；另外再训练一个 global negative policy，用来统一建模“所有不希望出现的行为”。这里的设计判断很关键：正向行为通常是 reward-specific 的，例如数学正确、工具调用格式正确、安全拒答，它们需要各自独立的优化方向；负向行为则可以合并，因为很多 failure mode 在“不要做”这个层面是可共享的。\n\n第二层，参数共享实现。为了避免真训练 N+1 个完整模型，PRISM 用一个共享 LM，加不同 prefix token 来条件化出不同子策略。也就是说，底座参数共享，子策略通过前缀路由到不同 mode。这样训练和部署成本都可控，也让不同子策略之间保留一定共享表示。\n\n第三层，组合方式。采样和推理时，不是选一个子策略，而是把各子策略的 logits 做加权组合，形成 mixture policy。论文强调 merge weights 是显式、可解释、可在 inference-time 调整的偏好接口。和 reward weighting 不同，这些权重不再直接作用于 noisy reward scale，而是作用于已经各自优化过的策略分布，因此更稳定，也更容易做 trade-off control。\n\n训练上，作者以 GRPO 为基础更新器。每个 reward 主要驱动其对应 positive branch 的更新，negative branch 则吸收各 reward 下的失败样本信号。这样做的目标是减少 conflicting rewards 在同一梯度中的直接干扰。和线性标量化、动态加权、Lagrangian constraint 类方法相比，区别不在 advantage estimator，而在“优化接口”从 reward scalar 转成了 policy mixture。全文里值得注意的一点是，作者并不是否认 Pareto trade-off 存在，而是认为把 trade-off 放到训练后、推理时的策略组合层面，比在训练时把所有目标压成一个标量更合适。","experiments":"实验覆盖三类多奖励场景：科学问答、工具调用、helpfulness-safety 对齐。\n\n1. 科学问答：在 GPQA 和 ScienceQA 上，PRISM 在所有 backbone 上都拿到最优 overall score。相对最强 baseline，分别在 Its value is to make the FFN an explicit dynamical term: FFNs are not just position-wise nonlinear capacity or editable memory tables; their tangential component can steer residual directions in a way that attention alone misses. This is useful for readers studying representation collapse, residual-stream geometry, FFN memories, or parallel approximations of Transformer blocks.","technical_approach":"The formulation decomposes each residual state as x_i = r_i u_i, where u_i lies on the unit sphere and r_i is the residual norm. Directional motion is studied on the sphere. Attention is modeled as a non-local aggregation field depending on other tokens, while the FFN is modeled as a local field depending only on the current token state. Only the tangential projection of a field changes the residual direction; the radial component changes the norm and therefore the angular speed. This leads to an aggregation-steering ODE on a product of spheres. The paper then defines critical residual directions, residual attractors, tangent stability, FFN-induced spectral shifts, and the attention–FFN commutator. It also introduces a sequential-to-parallel defect that measures when a finite attention–FFN block can be approximated by a parallel additive map. The technical difference from prior attention-only dynamics is the explicit inclusion of the FFN as a first-class steering term.","experiments":"The empirical analysis uses checkpoints from GPT-2, Pythia, Mistral, and Llama families. The main findings are: the attention branch alone has a substantial angular-alignment deficit relative to the actual block update; the tangential FFN component is necessary for the observed motion in residual-direction space, while the radial component cannot substitute for it; FFN steering helps maintain diversity under aggregation pressure; and the sequential-to-parallel defect can guide practical block parallelization approximations. Existing methods either train auxiliary sparse representations (e.g., sparse autoencoders, Transcoders) or train sparse models from scratch, which incur high compute overhead and may introduce a fidelity gap relative to the original dense model. There is currently no way to obtain usable circuit extraction units directly from an existing dense pretrained checkpoint without training additional representations.","importance":"Sparse Weight Decomposition (SWD) provides a low-cost path for interpretability analysis of pretrained models. It converts dense weights into sparse bottleneck units usable for circuit analysis, without retraining sparse models or auxiliary networks. The method offers a practical tool for studying internal mechanisms of pretrained models and validating the role of sparse connectivity, while also bridging model compression and interpretability research.","technical_approach":"SWD approximates the weight matrix W of a pretrained dense linear projection as the product of two sparse matrices A and B (W ≈ AB). Each intermediate coordinate corresponds to a bottleneck unit: it reads input via the corresponding column of A and writes output via the corresponding row of B, forming a rank-1 sparse path. The scalar activation of each unit can be independently scored, selected, and ablated, directly reusing the circuit extraction workflow designed for learned sparse features. SWD can use a small amount of calibration data to improve decomposition accuracy, or run in a zero-data variant that relies solely on weight matrices without calibration activations. Fixed-support fine-tuning can be applied after decomposition to recover model fidelity.","experiments":"For single MLP matrix replacement in GPT-2 Small and three Qwen2.5 models of different sizes, SWD achieves matched pre-pruning cross-entropy loss (i.e., comparable replacement fidelity) with less than 1% of the data required by baselines such as Transcoder and VPD. At matched fidelity, SWD requires fewer active read/write edges to reach the same circuit sufficiency and necessity thresholds. The method scales to single-matrix replacement on Qwen3.5-27B. When all 48 attention and MLP weight matrices across the 12 transformer blocks of GPT-2 Small are replaced simultaneously, SWD remains effective after fixed-support fine-tuning. The zero-data variant also produces useful bottleneck units. patch G，把 C 恢复到 H'。关键要求不是文本级完全回滚，而是行为上恢复相关健康状态。\n\n整个框架分四步。第一步是从 PR 提取任务证据，包括描述、实现 patch、可执行检查，并据此划分 target checks、regression checks 和 source change profile。这里的 source change profile 用来约束后续重建是否仍然忠于原始变更的作用范围和编辑强度。第二步是选择现代健康基线 H，优先使用声明的健康 revision 或目标 revision，否则在仓库 lineage 中解析默认分支的可运行后继版本。第三步是任务重建，采用三级递进策略：Level 1 Patch Reversal 适合历史 patch 与现代代码仍高度对应的情况，直接在现代代码上构造可逆任务状态；Level 2 Code Mapping 处理文件、符号、接口已经迁移但仍可建立映射的情况；Level 3 Agent Reconstruction 则在直接映射不足时，借助 agent 在现代仓库中重做变更。这个分层设计的意义在于，优先用便宜、确定性强的方法，只有在仓库演化破坏对应关系时才升级到更昂贵的重建方式。\n\n第四步是严格验证。系统要求 healthy、task、restored 三个状态都通过相应检查，并验证 provenance、behavior、scope、restoration。任务目标通过 adapter 抽象，支持 Bug Fix、Feature Addition、Test Generation、API Migration、Security Repair 等不同任务类型，每类任务定义自己的目标输出、可执行 oracle 和允许编辑范围。这个 adapter 个 matched Bug Fix 候选，Change2Task 成功重建 500 个，而 SWE-smith PR Mirror 为 387 个，显示在同类历史变更迁移任务上，三级重建策略比直接镜像式方法覆盖更高。\n\n质量方面，语料达到 0.894 的 task weighted source change profile fidelity，用来衡量现代重建任务与原始 PR It first decomposes interaction history into atomic memory items, which are organized into five independent functional memory banks: Goal, Task State, Constraint, Episodic Trace, and Reference Fact. Each item supports two rendering granularities: a fully detailed focal form, and a compact ambient form. At each decision step, the framework computes bank-level demand for the current task context and item-level relevance to the pending decision, then applies one of four operations to each item via a temporal presentation gate: promote, demote, retain, or hide. Selected focal and ambient memories are assembled into a structured prompt under a fixed per-step token budget for action generation.","experiments":"Implemented on a ReAct agent and evaluated on the ALFWorld embodied task benchmark, with strictly matched per-step memory token budgets across all methods.
